summary: Manages the creation, definition, and generation of LLM context files and data structures, serving as the core package for LLM context operations.
responsibilities: Defines document definitions, initializes and builds LLM contexts, and generates LLM context files.
relationships: The LLM context module coordinates context generation using document definitions and builder components.
design_decisions: Modular organization separating generation, definition, context initialization, and rendering components.
